$comment: Cross-schema invariant catalog — the machine-readable normative register of the 7 dependency-edge invariants the authoring family enforces ACROSS artifacts. Per intent-eval-lab plan 033 § 14.B (§ 14.B.1 edges, § 14.B.2 catalog, § 14.B.3 routing) + DR-044 (the SAK charter that makes the authoring family the SSoT). This catalog is the kernel-side declaration of WHAT each invariant is, WHERE it is enforced, and AT WHICH severity; the 6 STRUCTURAL invariants resolve across ARTIFACTS and are enforced in the deep validators named in `enforced_at` (validate-marketplace --deep / validate-plugin / validate-mcp / validate-skillmd). The one ADVISORY invariant (INV-ALLOWED-DISALLOWED) is kernel-checkable cross-field on a single skill-frontmatter and ships as a WARNING-level check in the kernel. The kernel exports one typed predicate-helper per invariant from src/validators/v1/authoring/cross-schema/cross-schema-invariants.ts for a deep validator to import; the cross-artifact descent wiring into validate-plugin/marketplace is out of kernel scope (REMAINDER).
title: Cross-schema invariant catalog (authoring family, v1)

catalogVersion.description: Semver of this catalog. A new/removed invariant or a changed severity is a catalog version event.

lineage.description: Machine-readable lineage: the governing decision record IS the upstream for this IS-authored cross-schema register.

invariants.description: The 7 cross-schema invariants from § 14.B.2, in catalog order.

edge.description: A dependency edge from § 14.B.1 (marketplace-catalog → plugin-manifest → {skill-frontmatter, agent-definition, mcp-config → hook-config}).

relation.description: cites/contains/refers-to per § 14.B.1; `self` for a single-artifact cross-FIELD invariant (no inter-artifact edge).

statement.description: The formal predicate text, verbatim from § 14.B.2.

enforced_at.description: The validator + mode from the § 14.B.2 'Where enforced' column.

class.description: § 14.B.3 routing class. Only INV-ALLOWED-DISALLOWED is advisory.

kernel_checkable.description: true when the predicate is decidable from a single artifact in the kernel (no cross-artifact resolution). Only INV-ALLOWED-DISALLOWED is kernel-checkable now; the 6 structural invariants need a deep validator's cross-artifact descent (the REMAINDER).

predicate_helper.description: The exported helper name in src/validators/v1/authoring/cross-schema/cross-schema-invariants.ts that a deep validator imports to evaluate this invariant per resolved pair.

invariants.statement: ∀ catalog entry e ∈ marketplace-catalog.plugins, plugin_manifest_resolves(e.source) ∧ valid_plugin_manifest(content_of(e.source), isMarketplace)
∀ p ∈ plugin-manifest, ∀ s ∈ p.skills, valid_skill_frontmatter(s, isMarketplace)
∀ p ∈ plugin-manifest, ∀ a ∈ p.agents, valid_agent_definition(a, isMarketplace)
∀ s ∈ skill-frontmatter with hooks block, valid_hook_config(s.hooks)
